blocks.text: “Laila” awoke in the middle of the night for a glass of water, checked her phone almost by accident, and saw an email that made her stomach drop. The US would stop funding the American University of Afghanistan (AUAF), one of the last places women can still study in the country. Laila said she sat on her bed, staring, her thoughts racing through the past five years and everything she had endured just to get an education. It had not been easy to find a way to study in Afghanistan after the Taliban outlawed women’s education. The American University campus was […]...
